question: I want to analyze New York City yellow taxi trip data specifically for January 1, 2015, using the bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015 dataset. I need to join this with the geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes table to map each trip to its respective NYC zip code based on the pickup coordinates. The analysis should create a complete hour-by-hour breakdown for all zip codes by cross-joining distinct zip codes with distinct hours, including hours with zero trips. For each zip code and hour combination, calculate the total number of trips and the following time-based metrics: count of trips from 1 hour ago, 1 day (24 hours) ago, 7 days (168 hours) ago, and 14 days (336 hours) ago. Additionally, compute the 14-day and 21-day moving averages and standard deviations of trip counts, excluding the current hour. Only include trips with valid latitude and longitude coordinates. The final results should be sorted by the highest trip counts, showing only the top 5 groups with the most trips.

-- Let me re-run the final query to get a fresh query_id
WITH nyc_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_code = 'NY'
),
hours AS (
  SELECT 0 as hour UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
  UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
  UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
  UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
),
all_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    t.pickup_datetime,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM t.pickup_datetime) as trip_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2014` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2014-12-11' AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    t.pickup_datetime,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM t.pickup_datetime) as trip_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2014-12-11' AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
),
hourly_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, trip_date, hour, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM all_trips
  GROUP BY zip_code, trip_date, hour
),
all_combos AS (
  SELECT nz.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM nyc_zips nz
  CROSS JOIN hours h
),
jan1_base AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.zip_code,
    ac.hour,
    COALESCE(hc.trip_count, 0) as trip_count
  FROM all_combos ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON ac.zip_code = hc.zip_code AND ac.hour = hc.hour AND hc.trip_date = '2015-01-01'
),
lookback_1hr AS (
  SELECT ac.zip_code, ac.hour,
    COALESCE(hc.trip_count, 0) as count_1hr_ago
  FROM all_combos ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON ac.zip_code = hc.zip_code 
    AND hc.trip_date = '2014-12-31'
    AND hc.hour = CASE WHEN ac.hour = 0 THEN 23 ELSE ac.hour - 1 END
),
lookback_1day AS (
  SELECT ac.zip_code, ac.hour,
    COALESCE(hc.trip_count, 0) as count_1day_ago
  FROM all_combos ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON ac.zip_code = hc.zip_code 
    AND hc.trip_date = '2014-12-31'
    AND hc.hour = ac.hour
),
lookback_7day AS (
  SELECT ac.zip_code, ac.hour,
    COALESCE(hc.trip_count, 0) as count_7days_ago
  FROM all_combos ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON ac.zip_code = hc.zip_code 
    AND hc.trip_date = '2014-12-25'
    AND hc.hour = ac.hour
),
lookback_14day AS (
  SELECT ac.zip_code, ac.hour,
    COALESCE(hc.trip_count, 0) as count_14days_ago
  FROM all_combos ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON ac.zip_code = hc.zip_code 
    AND hc.trip_date = '2014-12-18'
    AND hc.hour = ac.hour
),
ma_14day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(trip_count), COUNT(*)) as ma_14day,
    STDDEV_SAMP(trip_count) as sd_14day
  FROM hourly_counts
  WHERE trip_date >= '2014-12-18' AND trip_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
ma_21day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(trip_count), COUNT(*)) as ma_21day,
    STDDEV_SAMP(trip_count) as sd_21day
  FROM hourly_counts
  WHERE trip_date >= '2014-12-11' AND trip_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
)
SELECT 
  j.zip_code,
  j.hour,
  j.trip_count,
  l1.count_1hr_ago,
  l2.count_1day_ago,
  l7.count_7days_ago,
  l14.count_14days_ago,
  ROUND(m14.ma_14day, 2) as ma_14day,
  ROUND(m14.sd_14day, 2) as sd_14day,
  ROUND(m21.ma_21day, 2) as ma_21day,
  ROUND(m21.sd_21day, 2) as sd_21day
FROM jan1_base j
JOIN lookback_1hr l1 ON j.zip_code = l1.zip_code AND j.hour = l1.hour
JOIN lookback_1day l2 ON j.zip_code = l2.zip_code AND j.hour = l2.hour
JOIN lookback_7day l7 ON j.zip_code = l7.zip_code AND j.hour = l7.hour
JOIN lookback_14day l14 ON j.zip_code = l14.zip_code AND j.hour = l14.hour
LEFT JOIN ma_14day m14 ON j.zip_code = m14.zip_code AND j.hour = m14.hour
LEFT JOIN ma_21day m21 ON j.zip_code = m21.zip_code AND j.hour = m21.hour
ORDER BY j.trip_count DESC
LIMIT 5

## ST_CONTAINS

Returns TRUE if a GEOGRAPHY or GEOMETRY object is completely inside another object of the same type.
More strictly, object g1 contains object g2 if and only if no points of g2 lie in the exterior of g1, and at least one point of the interior of B lies in the interior of A.
